title: lichen-node --lib has 18 pre-existing test failures on main
description:
cargo test -p lichen-node --lib on current main (3e42daffaf) fails 18 tests; worker4 verified identical failure set with the v9ke announce-destination changes applied (so they are NOT caused by that fix). Failure groups observed (full list in failure set):
- node::tests::{grouped_delegated_prefix_dao_is_forwarded_by_parent_and_processed_by_root, leaf_dao_is_forwarded_by_parent_and_processed_by_root}: assertion left == right at node.rs DaoForwarded{next_hop: 2000::1} vs (0, None) — test expects NOT forwarded, code forwards.
- routing::tests::{dao_clock_expires_across_u32_boundary, dao_clock_expires_after_half_range_gap, dao_is_rejected_when_no_future_deadline_is_representable, exact_dao_at_expiry_reports_accepted_update, finite_route_expires_during_idle_lookup_and_timer, garbage_version_authorization_rejects_increase_without_state_change, processing_dao_expires_routes_with_active_lifetime_unit, spoofed_dao_target_is_rejected_before_replay_state_changes, root_authorized_version_propagates_across_two_hops_and_tampering_fails, ...}: process_dio/process_dao admission and route-expiry assertions failing.
Likely related to recent root-signature/version-authorization (b7z9.37.x) or DAO admission gate changes that landed without updating these tests, or a behavior regression. Reproduce: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<tmp> cargo test -p lichen-node --lib. Needs investigation: decide whether code or tests are wrong (respect upstream AddrForKey decision); fix accordingly. Note: cargo test -p lichen-node -p lichen-gateway hides these because the run stops at the lichen-gateway end_to_end failures (tracked in project-LICHEN-worker6-8rm3).
